principles.rawPreserved: Provider transcript stored verbatim; never discarded
principles.markersOnly: Normalization adds [UNCLEAR] markers; never removes words
principles.errorsFlagged: Probable transcription errors annotated but wording preserved
principles.noSilentCorrection: Never fix wording, grammar, or facts without owner review
principles.ownerCorrectionsNewPreview: Any owner change creates new preview with new ID, hash, and approval

UNCLEAR.meaning: Phrase is nonsensical or incomplete; must not drive actions
UNCLEAR.example: request to leave information in utility [UNCLEAR]

PROBABLE_TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR.meaning: Likely provider transcription artifact; preserved exactly
PROBABLE_TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR.example: The roof is the ten years old

records: Every annotation with type, phrase, and reason
Statement that no wording changes were applied (if none)

normalizationDoesNot: Redact or omit content (except empty transport segments)
